event_title: Tactical Touhou: A Look at Military-themed Touhou Works
event_description: The juxtaposition of cute girls doing not-so-cute things has long been a troupe in the Otaku community, and “Girls with Guns” has long been a very popular subgenre in the space. Touhou, with its normally care-free and cutesy setting, has historically been a very popular platform for showing off this contrast, with a huge variety of militarized depictions of its characters and setting. In this panel, we will cover fanart, doujins, fangames, and cosplays of “kitted-out” Touhou characters throughout the years, along with some of the canon references in official works to armed conflict.

Our Discord-hosted gaming event is being brought on location! Every month, we host a game night in the TouhouFest Discord where we play a variety of multiplayer games, with each month's game choice being decided by members of the server. For this month, we will be playing both Mario Kart 8 Deluxe & Mario Kart World (and potentially more). Please note, you will need your own controller or system to play along, and a controller adapter for Gamecube Controllers will be provided if necessary.

event_title: The Art of Danmaku: The Basics of Touhou Game Mechanics and Elegant Danmaku Patterns
event_description: Have you ever been at awe of the danmaku patterns in your favourite Touhou games which are visually complex yet simple in elegance? Even more, have you always wanted to make a Touhou game of your own, yet felt completely lost on where even to begin? Here, we'll explore the process of making a Touhou game and the most important part, how to construct bosses and danmaku patterns. While programming will be demonstrated, we will do our best to illustrate and describe concepts as simply as possible using at most high school mathematics.

event_title: Gensokyo Geography 101: or How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love Speculation
event_description: A short primer and presentation on the possible "where" and "what" of various popular locations around Gensokyo, as well as a dedicated focus and speculation (with sources) of the original formation of Gensokyo.

Silly little plushies have taken over the world. The end is near. How do we stop them? First we must learn about them. Go undercover, they say. So, we must learn what we can. What tactics do they use for global domination? Who are scalpers? How can we stop them? 

Why will one be given away at the end? 

At the end, you will all also receive your bachelors degrees in Fumology! Thanks for coming along this ride.

The follow on to last year's [i] Queering Gensokyo [/i], Yuri in Fansokyo covers the wide variety of inter cast shipping that existed in the Touhou Fandom. In this panel, we will discuss fanworks that depict lesbian relationships. Discussion will focus around the who and why these fanworks are produced, and their intended audience. Both the western and eastern sides of the fandom will be discussed. Audience Participation is welcome.

event_title: Beyond the Sonic Boundaries: Odd, Obscure, & Unorthodox Touhou Music
event_description: “There is a Touhou arrangement for every genre” but what does that bold claim actually entail? Prepare to discover new musical worlds in this showcase of underappreciated arrangement styles. Learn about and listen to unique circles and albums specializing in these one-of-a-kind sounds, and explore doujin music scenes happening outside of Japan! An open heart and open ears is recommended.

event_title: Gensokyo You Can! Moriya Shrine: The Gateway to Touhou Pilgrimage
event_description:
Despite Gensokyo is dangerous for humans, we can safely explore many of its inspirations through Touhou Pilgrimages. Did you know Lake Suwa, home of the Moriya Trio, is an excellent introduction?

The panel will briefly cover the locale and culture that inspired the Moriya Shrine and its residents, Fandom Presences and Fanwork References.

With 5 duos and 7 performances, get ready for an hour of hilarious hijinks!

event_title: Touhou and TTRPGS – Running a D20 roleplaying game in Gensokyo
event_description:
Do you want to explore the world of Touhou in the company of your friends? Tabletop Roleplaying Games (TTRPGS) allow you and your friends to do so. In this 45-minute panel, two experienced Game Masters talk about their experience adapting the world of Touhou to their TTRPG of choice - Pathfinder 2nd Edition. They discuss how to make your game feel like Touhou by adapting game mechanics to fit Touhou characters and common elements of TTRPGS to avoid in your Touhou campaign. The panelists share anecdotes from previous Touhou campaigns in order to answer one overarching question - What makes a roleplaying campaign feel like Touhou?

event_title: How to be good at Touhou (Wait. Touhou has a videogame!?)
event_description:
Yes. Touhou is a videogame.
Now... how can I tryhard at it? Are you willing to give up your mental well-being? Are you willing to endure the pain? Are you willing to humble yourself towards a new experience of what a hard game is? 
Let me hold your hand (non-romantically) to teach you the very basics of the official bullet-hell games, and how to enjoy (and dying while trying) colorful and amazing bullet patterns.

event_title: Touhou Cold Read Comedy Grand Prix!
event_description: Like comedy skits? Want to try your hand at comedic acting? Think you're good at improv? Doesn't matter! Come on down to witness or participate in a comedic gauntlet where contestants from all over the state will do whatever it takes to win the grand prize!!! Teams of two or three will demonstrate their comedic prowess (or lack of it!) in an attempt to impress 5 judges, whose scores will determine which teams are eliminated. When only two teams remain, they will face off in the grand finals.

So You Think You Know Touhou… Join us in a fun filled Game show as your knowledge of the series and all that surrounds it is put to the test. Compete against others and have a chance to take home the grand prize if you can outsmart the competition!

event_title: Even A Monkey Can Draw Anime Girls! How Touhou 1draw Can Improve Your Art Skills
event_description: Does looking at pretty Touhou art make your heart yearn, wishing you could draw like that? Struggled to get started? Lost motivation? Don't worry, Jennifer Raye has been there too, and she'll show you how to fight your evil brain demons and start drawing pretty anime girls right here, right now! Simple drawing supplies will be provided, but bringing your own is recommended.

event_title: Elite Ball Knowledge: A Guide to Touhou Reiiden
event_description: Are you interested in seeing where Touhou began, but baffled by the strangeness of a game so unique? Are you already familiar with the game, but want to know more? Do you just want a strategy guide? This panel is for you! Chroma has spent many moons cultivating her Ball Knowledge, and would like to share said knowledge with the convention.

event_title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Audiovisual Syncing in Touhou Games
event_description: Everyone knows that Touhou music is top-notch, but what you might've missed are the small details ZUN uses to bind each track to its in-game setting, whether by making effective use of backgrounds, syncing danmaku attacks to the beat, or integrating the song into a boss fight. Join williewillus, author of the well-known "Top Touhou Music Syncs" video, for a deep-dive into the nitty-gritty details that elevate Touhou music beyond a simple video game OST.

The monumental 20th installment of the long running Touhou comedy show!

For this screening, watch as duos of Touhou characters act out comedy routines on stage to try and get the most laughs from the audience!

With 5 duos and 7 performances, get ready for an hour of hilarious hijinks!

event_title: What the Hell? -Quick History of Bullet Hells / Danmaku
event_description: Join us for a rapid tour through the evolution of bullet hell shooters! From their arcade beginnings to genre‑defining titles like DoDonPachi and Touhou. We’ll break down how danmakus became known for intricate patterns, high‑skill play, and a passionate global fanbase. We’ll also look at where the genre is headed through the indie scene.
